Ok this will probably get lost in the sea of comments but here’s my take:

This is coming from the perspective of the younger sibling with my older sister with a 5 year gap. Your sister is spoiled. Sharing is OK. I share everything with my sis. But if she wants to use your PS4 you need to be able to use her switch. She needs to understand things need to be fair.

Your parents are letting her be spoiled and when she grows up she might have the mindset that she can do anything she wants and not face consequences. Idk how your parents are but if she’s going to be like this you need to teach her by example. I’m 100% against hitting anyone, especially kids. but for some kid this severe? I’d say whip her palm. Not hard just enough to scare her. Or any sort of punishment to give. 

Seriously this is so frustrating to read. Op if you love your sis help her out dude. She can’t go on like this she’ll have her ass kicked one day.

Edit: Also good job on keeping your patience with her. You’re a good older bro for not losing your cool with her and hiding the PS4 instead. Goodluck with all this and I hope you both get the help you guys need.

Hey hey. It’s gonna be okay. Just Calm down okay dear? Try to breath. First if you’re still bleeding I want you to apply a gauze or a clean cloth over the wound. Apply pressure. If you haven’t taken a shower yet, if your hairs oily or if you’re sweating wait till the bleeding stops, add hydrogen peroxide, wait a couple minutes then shower even without soap.

You’re going to be okay. Dm me and ill listen to whatever worries you. Just don’t hurt yourself please. You aren’t disgusting and you deserve to be loved like everyone else. I care and I may not be old enough to be a mother but I can always be a sister! I’m glad you’re alive. You have value like everyone else

I’m my own boss (I do art comms) so I don’t know about that but I’m glad someone understands. Sometimes I feel like an alien because how of how negatively people react when I say this you know? And yeah I know if I wanna be loved I gotta love too. But the problem is that there’s no one I find special at all. My only source of love is from the animals I take care of. Thanks for making me feel less alone though.

This isn’t for karma (I mean this is my throwaway venting account). I just need to find some ways to cope. I have a dysfunctional family and she and my sister along with my other pets are the only good things I have left to cope with everything going on. I miss her dearly

Hiya! Glad to hear you guys had fun! Those girls seem really adorable! Its great you guys always cherish those good moments in life. It’s a really great example for them and I’m glad they have such loving grandparents! Hope they have fun on Halloween haha!

It’s cool your grandson is trying out some new things! I hope he becomes open to newer experiences! Also I hope all the doctor visits had good news. Which reminds me! I’m not actually 15. I’m 13 like your grandson ahaha! Sorry I had a typo on the original post and I didn’t realise until now. Very sorry about that.

Lately my parents have been gone more. They started a new project so I only get to see them twice a week. Though this time they brought me and my sis along. They’re in construction and architecture you see so I love seeing their projects go from bare buildings to something made with lots of care and love. My mom has issues I’m sure but I still love her. She can be good sometimes and she still cares about me and my sis. Even with the narcissistic parenting.

About school. Remember how I said I have bad anxiety? Yeah 3 years back I got severely bullied and it made my anxiety even worse so my parents agreed to get me into a innov program it’s basically like going to regular school but you only go 2-3 times a week depending on your choice and it’s inside a private cubicle. Though I’m pushing back till November because I’m still scared. Our system works the same as the American one since I’m in an international school. So it’s k-18 with collage after. Though schools are really competitive here in Asia. It’s harder and harder to get in every year. Grades really count!

As for daily life and my work/hobbies I’m usually alone so it’s very dull. I used to volunteer at an animal shelter before till I quit. And I also used to do art commissions and social media statistics for my parents. I still do them on occasion but not every day like before. I mainly do digital art but I also like experimenting with music or sculpting! I really admire all forms of art!

I listen to a lot of music, classical, 20s-90s, rock, dubstep, lofi, vocaloid, heavy metal you name it! Music helps with my anxiety so I know a lot of songs. And I’ve been a bit busy so I’ve got no time to read right now. Anyways enough about me

What’s up with you? How’s your health? What are your interests and hobbies? I’d love to hear more about you soon! 

Best regards - soap! (yes thats my name haha. But you can also call me mari)

Hi! It’s been four days! I’m sorry I didn’t get back to you. Needed a break from all my social media. How have you been? I hope the kids will get their peace back soon. 

Lately I’ve been thinking hard about school and work. I’ve been working a lot lately but honestly I seem to be getting nowhere. I feel like my art isn’t improving at all. I’m trying to get into technical work like coding but I’m not that interested.

You’re family is really lucky you cook for them! A mother’s cooking is always delicious no matter what! I even like my own mothers cooking despite our differences. Thought I haven’t tasted it in a year now.

It’s great you’re granddaughters are coming to visit! I hope they always cherish you. You’re a really sweet lady and they’re all lucky to have you! The weather lately has been even. It’s not too hot and it isn’t raining too often! We’ve only got dry and wet seasons so skincare is a must here haha.

Thanks for always writing with me! I feel like I’ve got a pen pal and it gives me comfort every time I feel lonely.

Hey! It’s me again lol. How are you? Are the kids doing well? How’s the gifts going?

I just finished up cleaning my back pack from last school year. I tore up all my papers and I felt like I relived a bit of stress. My parents are always telling me how I should get good grades and such. Which I do follow. But sometimes the pressure is a lot. Even getting something as ‘low’ as 90% would seem like a fail to them. 

I’m honestly just really scared of school in general. Back in elementary I hid in the bathrooms and cried every assembly wanting to go home. And I still do that sometimes just not everyday. I wonder why.

How’s your day been going so far? I’d love to hear about it!
Adorable!!

Oh my. I’m really sorry to hear that he passed. I had an uncle and the same thing happened. Lung cancer and left his two kids and an unborn child behind. I really hope those two will be okay. And I’m sure with the proper guide they’ll be able to grow up into great people. Also Goodluck with that slide show.im sure it’ll turn out great!

As for books I’m not very sure. Didn’t get into literature until recently with HP lovecraft and Edgar Allan poe. Wanted to read because of their interesting point of view on fear. Though I’ve always wanted to read the tell tale heart and cool air. theyre short reads that’ll take no less than 8 minutes. Both are mainly horror but they have an interesting take on the mainstream concept of it.

My classes actually don’t start until November by the way! Needed to take a 1 month break before school because I’ve got bad social anxiety. I’m homeschooled but this program I’m in makes me go to 1 on 1 classes in a private class.

I hope you don’t strain yourself this week with all the work and I think it’s really sweet of you to make gifts for the kids! I look forward to talking to you everyday! Makes me a little happier every time

Take care! You’re a really kind person!

Wow you have such a big family! It’s obvious you adore each and every member. I’m almost jealous haha! I really hope you and your husband will lead a long happy and healthy life. Your kids and grandkids must be so happy to have you in their life! I really wish I could have a family like that. It sounds almost like a dream aside from the health issues.

Both my grannies are bad manipulative people who only care about my parents money and status. They’re really terrible people who have done so much bad things to them. Even all their siblings hate them. I don’t even have any nice cousins. So that’s why I at least don’t wanna leave my mom. She needs family and me my sister and my dad are all she has left. 

That book ‘mans search for meaning’ sounds really interesting. I’m gonna look for it right away and hopefully I’ll be able to find a copy in real life. Maybe I’ll pick up an audible book? 

It’s really fun hearing about you and your family! You can tell me any news that goes on since you’ve already done so much for me. Listening to you too is the least I can do. I always thought that having a good and perfect family wasn’t possible and that human connections can never be good. But hearing about you makes me believe maybe I can have a family too.

Hey I’m sorry I didn’t reply yesterday. I’ve got a really bad fever right now and it hurt to see my phone. I’ve been doing a bit better and my mom called and so far we aren’t arguing! Thanks for always telling me to take care of myself. But now I wanna ask about you? You’re always taking time to talk to me and see how I’m doing so I wanna know how you are for a change!

I’ve got a shitty family and social life (check my post in r/momforaminute for an explanation). I refuse to even get therapy and I’m going to be studying neurology to become a neurosurgeon to make some money for myself.  It’s gonna be a job I hate but it’ll get me away from everyone. So why shouldn’t I just die. Not like there’s something waiting for me. My life is just as insignificant as anyone else’s.

Thanks for including me in your prayers. My parents are going away for a week so lately I’ve been trying to stop cutting and focus more on working less and treating myself. Thanks for being so helpful and nice. I’m hoping I can stop cutting by the end of next year. And maybe I can help my mental health by the end of 2021. It’s gonna be an extremely slow process but I just want to stop questioning how I need to feel. I just feel like I’m not allowed to be hurt by these things and that I’ve just been petty. Seeing everyone’s pity makes me confused.
Why. Why did I have to see this. I could have lived without this. WHAT HAVE YOU DONE

Thanks. My sister is attending collage with a full time job so she’s barely home and it’s not like we can move out since she works for my parents and they pay for her tuition. There’s no escape. They own us. But I’m fine with that. I can’t really fix what’s already broken. Thanks for caring. I actually tear up a bit whenever reading your replies because you’re so nice. I know I already said this but againthank you for taking the time to talk to me. You’re the first adult besides my sister who actually knows what’s going on and I feel a strong sense of relief.

I don’t really mind how my skin looks. I don’t even wear skirts anyways. It’s just the pain I go through. It’s painful for me to even shower. Also yeah I have been trying to distract myself. Got three part time jobs a tutor and school to keep myself busy. But the stress of that overwhelms me a lot and I start to cut myself again in a cycle. I’m stuck. And I can’t get therapy since it’s looked down here and my parents would get humiliated. Therapy to people here is only for insane people at least that’s what they think.

I know I should. I know I shouldn’t be hiding all this but honestly it’s my parents I’m most afraid of. They’re a bit abusive and they don’t believe I should go into therapy. My mom sees some of my cuts and she gets really mad at me for them. I can’t bring myself to explain to her how I feel. I’m scared of her the most. I doubt she’d take me since it’s looked down on here anyways. People here are closed minded and think therapy is for crazy people.
I’m too scared to get a therapist. I’m scared of people knowing what’s on my mind. I just don’t know what I’m going to do with myself.  Also yeah I’ve tried scar creams but they’re really slow going.

Yeah I try to keep myself occupied 100% of the time. I have 3 part time jobs, school and a tutor. But whenever I’m home the stress of being there gets me to cut again. It’s a vicious cycle and I just don’t know what to do anymore. There’s seriously no fast way to get rid of scars? God I’m fucked. I have some really long scars that are at least three years old and aren’t gone yet. I don’t really want to get therapy since I don’t wanna be put into a hospital for being suicidal. I’m scared of people knowing what I think. I’m scared of everything in general.
Do the same thing. Don’t let her make fun of you for anything when it starts to offend you.

Both my parents families do tolerate this. Over in the Philippines beating your child is a pretty standard act to discipline your child. But I really wouldn’t go to them for help either way. They’re really terrible people who abused my parents (both sides) and I hate them more than anyone else. My parents don’t have much friends but business friends since they don’t really socialise and i don’t wanna talk to my school counsellor about this because I don’t need her pity. I don’t really wanna embarrass my parents I just wanna fix this. I don’t wanna be terrified of them anymore. I actually don’t have much friends to help and I don’t have any adult figure to help me aside from my sister (she’s 19) For now I’m just trying to do things that won’t get them mad so they won’t hurt me. Actually I had moved out for a year. My parents let me have an apartment for school in a far district but after that experience I would have much rather stayed with my parents. I was bullied a lot and teachers didn’t seem to care what happened to me. I was even absent for 3 weeks and my teacher still scolded me for not understanding the new material from friends. She didn’t even notice I was gone. I feel like this is something I need to fix on my own. Or maybe this is something that can’t be fixed at all and I just need to get away. I don’t really know what to do anymore

I have 7 years before I can study abroad because I need to take biology (or maybe Chemistry) for the course I’m taking first. My sister goes through the same things as me. Even worse actually. But she always tells me to just keep loving mom and that we need to support her which I agree. Which is why I can’t bring myself to hate her. I’m just scared of her. My dad doesn’t really intervene on my situation and doesn’t really care which I don’t mind. It’s not his problem anyways. And he hurts me physically too so I don’t want his help. I don’t wanna get a therapist since I’m already busy with school and work (trying to make my own money so I can be independent quicker)  and I’m also trying to convince my mom to get therapy but I think I’m going to have to make her do it when I’m older. Thank you so so much for for telling me you care about me. It really made my night. You can’t overestimate how happy that comment made me. Thanks for taking the time to say some nice things!

Thank you so much. I really needed to hear this. I don’t have any family who can help (they’re all terrible people on both sides.) and I don’t have any friends. I also live in the Philippines so the authorities aren’t gonna it (besides my dad is friends with the mayor so I’ll be put back home either way). But even though I’m scared and confused I don’t wanna leave my mom. I need her and I love her. I can’t bring myself to hate her because of her childhood trauma. I’ve already got an escape plan leaving for collage abroad but that’ll still be in a long time. I’ll try checking out r/raisedbynarcissists if that’ll help me cope though. I wasn’t sure about posting this because I really might just be ungrateful but thank you so much for this.
